title: Update release notes, pulling in missing releases
body:
Previously, I've just been grabbing release notes from the most recent branch. This has the notable downside that, if I forget to do this, main gets really out of date, and the second notable downside that releases on older branches usually don't make it in at all.

In an attempt to avoid this, I've written a script that pulls the release notes directly from our tags on Github. I've added a limit so we won't go earlier than v0.8.4 (the first release with proper release notes).

The result has a fair number of changes which can be attributed to diffs between the release notes in the repo and the ones on the tags (probably a bad thing...) and picked up a lot of missing releases.

If this works out, we can hopefully start doing this automatically on tag push to auto-update the release notes on main.

comments.body: Lot of the diffstat looks like `github.com/containers/podman` swapping to `github.com/containers/libpod` - we find-replaced the release notes in the repo, but not on the tag. Shouldn't really matter?
(If we do care, I could get the script to auto-change URLs to `podman-container-tools/podman` automatically

> (If we do care, I could get the script to auto-change URLs to podman-container-tools/podman automatically

I think that'll be helpful and potentially a one-time effort once we get this automated.
